description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Sets how voices say `term` for a brand: `sayAs` is a plain respelling (e.g. "Dahss-tuhl"). Updates the entry with that term (case-insensitive; accepts a waiting suggestion) or creates one; fields left out keep their values. `acceptedHearings` are transcriptions Verify also counts as a pass. Applies to every voice from the next render, with no per-call setup.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/pronunciations/upsert.)

acceptedHearings.description: Transcriptions Verify also counts as a pass.

alsoRecord.description: Also tell a human voice actor (default true).

name: pronunciations_upsert
title: Set a pronunciation
